description: Header file defining parsing functions for various data types and environment variables, likely used in a larger Git-related C project.

methods.name: git_parse_signed
methods.description: Parses a string as a signed integer, returning the result via pointer, with a maximum value limit.

methods.name: git_parse_unsigned
methods.description: Parses a string as an unsigned integer, returning the result via pointer, with a maximum value limit.

methods.name: git_parse_ssize_t
methods.description: Parses a string as ssize_t type value.

methods.name: git_parse_ulong
methods.description: Parses a string as unsigned long.

methods.name: git_parse_maybe_bool
methods.description: Parses a string as a boolean value, returning -1 on error.

methods.name: git_parse_maybe_bool_text
methods.description: Parses boolean text from a string.

methods.name: git_env_bool
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable as a boolean integer.

methods.name: git_env_ulong
